input.quote: 9. TRUELINK WARRANTIES. TrueLink represents and warrants that the Interface and all related software (i) is designed to be used before, on and after January l, 2000;
input.rationale: The only TrueLink warranty (Section 9) is a Year 2000 date-handling warranty; there is no warranty that the Interface or software conforms to its documentation, no services conformance warranty with a duration, and no repair/replacement or refund remedy. Section 11 (Standard of Care) is a bare performance covenant with no warranty period or remedy, and Section 3 contains only reasonable-efforts service levels. The disclaimer at p0076 is limited to implied warranties and opens \"EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT\", so it preserves an express warranty once inserted, but as drafted there is effectively no conformance warranty at all. This fails the fallback, so we insert one short warranty running ninety (90) days for both the software and the Services, with a repair/replacement or refund remedy. We have not pressed the preferred twelve-month software period, professional-and-workmanlike, compliance-with-laws or malicious-code warranties in this edit.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 warrants only Year 2000 date handling, so there is no express warranty that the Interface or the Hosting and Support Services will actually conform. We have added a short conformance warranty running ninety (90) days for both the software and the Services, with a repair/replacement or refund remedy; this sits at our fallback, our preferred position being twelve (12) months for software.
proposal.summary: Insert a 90-day vendor conformance warranty for software and Services with repair/replace or refund remedy after Section 9.

ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that, for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery or performance, the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation and the Hosting Services and Support Services will conform in all material respects to the requirements of this Agreement. Client's remedy for breach of the foregoing warranties is, at TrueLink's option, repair or replacement of the non-conforming software or re-performance of the non-conforming Services, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming software or Services.
